rationale: The previous candidate further reduced base_speed to 0.8, kd to 0.5, and increased ki to 2.0 to improve stability and reduce stalling on the slalom track, but the track still failed to finish any runs. The evaluator suggests that if stalling persists, we should consider lowering base_speed further to 0.7 and possibly changing the line loss strategy to 'search_left' or 'search_right' to actively search for the line. Also, if steering oscillation remains high, kd should be reduced further, and if rms_error or line loss events remain elevated, ki should be increased. Given the persistent stalling and the cautious tuning trend, I will lower base_speed to 0.7 to improve stability and switch the line loss strategy to 'search_left' to actively steer right when the line is lost, which may help recover from line loss more effectively. I will keep kd at 0.5 and ki at 2.0 for now, as these values have been beneficial in smoothing steering and correcting steady-state errors. The geometry and sensor layout remain unchanged as they have been stable and effective. I continue to request the same measurements to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss, and steering oscillation. I expect these changes to reduce stalling on the slalom track, improve line recovery during line loss, and maintain smooth steering and good line tracking overall.
